description: This file defines an internal interface and a sealed class related to message filtering in the Orleans runtime's repartitioning process. The class implements logic to determine if a message is acceptable based on grain migratability and whether the message involves the same grain as sender and target.

classes.name: RepartitionerMessageFilter
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IRepartitionerMessageFilter, responsible for filtering messages based on migratability and grain identity.

methods.name: IsAcceptable
methods.description: Determines if a message is acceptable for processing based on whether the sender or target grains are migratable and if they are the same grain.
